name: research-harness
description: V8 research pipeline for Claude Code: three workflows on the native Workflow runtime — research (speculative DeepResearch with ResearchStudio transformation priors → one Claim with contract rows), experiment (adaptive plan/build/judge loop: cheapest decision-changing test, B1 spec, canary launch, deterministic invalidity ≠ refutation), paper (draft from evidence) — driven one line per turn by dag.py. Opus/Sol/K3 hold the few judgment seats, GLM does the reading and building, Grok CLI reviews code.
